welcome.hi-IN: Namaste! BharatVani mein aapka swagat hai. Aap kya jaanna chahte hain?
welcome.en-IN: Namaste! Welcome to BharatVani. How can I help you today?
welcome.ta-IN: Vanakkam! BharatVani ku ungalai varaverkirom. Naan eppadi udhava mudiyum?
welcome.te-IN: Namaskaram! BharatVani ki swagatham. Nenu miku ela sahayam cheyagalanu?
welcome.bn-IN: Namaskar! BharatVani-te apnake swagoto. Ami apnake kibhabe sahajyo korte pari?
welcome.mr-IN: Namaskar! BharatVani madhye aaple swagat aahe. Mi tujhi kashi madat karu shakto?

welcome_returning.hi-IN: Namaste! BharatVani mein phir se swagat hai. Aaj kya madad karoon?
welcome_returning.en-IN: Welcome back to BharatVani! How can I help you today?
welcome_returning.ta-IN: Meendum Vanakkam! Inru naan eppadi udhava mudiyum?
welcome_returning.te-IN: Malli swagatham! Iroju nenu miku ela sahayam cheyagalanu?
welcome_returning.bn-IN: Abar swagoto! Aaj ami apnake kibhabe sahajyo korte pari?
welcome_returning.mr-IN: Punha swagat aahe! Aaj mi tujhi kashi madat karu shakto?

nudge.hi-IN: Kya aap kuch poochna chahte hain? Main sun raha hoon.
nudge.en-IN: Would you like to ask something? I'm listening.
nudge.ta-IN: Neengal ethavathu ketka virumbugirirgala? Naan ketkondirukkiren.
nudge.bn-IN: Apni ki kichu jiggasha korte chan? Ami shunchi.
nudge.mr-IN: Tumhala kahi vicharaycha aahe ka? Mi aikat aahe.

goodbye.hi-IN: Shukriya! BharatVani har samay aapki seva mein hai. Dobara call karein!
goodbye.en-IN: Thank you! BharatVani is always here to help. Call again anytime!
goodbye.ta-IN: Nandri! BharatVani eppodhum udhava thayaragavullathu. Meendum azhaikkavum!
goodbye.te-IN: Dhanyavadalu! BharatVani eppudu miku sahayam cheyadaniki siddhamga undi. Malli call cheyandi!
goodbye.bn-IN: Dhonnobad! BharatVani shob shomoy apnar sathe ache. Abar call korben!
goodbye.mr-IN: Dhanyavad! BharatVani nehemi tumchya madatisathi aahe. Punha call kara!
